xna-type.name: PipelineException
xna-type.summary: Thrown when errors are encountered during a content pipeline build.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the PipelineException class with the specified error message.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.
[ ParamArrayAttribute ] Array of strings specifying message-related arguments.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the PipelineException class with the specified error message.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.

constructor.summary: Creates an instance of PipelineException with information on serialization and streaming context for the related content item.
constructor.syntax: protected PipelineException ( SerializationInfo serializationInfo, StreamingContext streamingContext )

parameters.parameter: Information necessary for serialization and deserialization of the content item.
Information necessary for the source and destination of a given serialized stream. Also provides an additional caller-defined context.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the PipelineException class with the specified error message and a reference to the inner exception that is the cause of this exception.

parameters.parameter: A message that describes the error.
The exception that is the cause of the current exception. If is not a null reference, the current exception is raised in a catch block that handles the inner exception.
